plan: Since this is the first round, I have no history to learn from. The optimal bidding strategy in a second-price auction with complete information is to bid truthfully. However, with incomplete information, bidders shade their bids. A common strategy is to bid slightly below your value. I will bid 46.9, slightly below my value of 47.

This is a single-round auction. Since all bidders are rational, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below your value. In a single-round auction, there's no future to consider, so risk aversion is less of a factor. I will bid a fraction of my value, slightly less than my value to ensure a profit if I win. I will bid 32.9, which is slightly below my value of 33.

This is a single-round auction, and my value is $36. With rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my value. However, since this is just one round, I will bid a bit more aggressively to try and win. I will bid $35.50, which is less than my value but still gives me a good chance of winning.
